changelog:
Draw a line on an AI camera's view to get an alert when a person or vehicle crosses it.
UniFi Protect cameras are found on your network, and Protect's stream links can be added.
Found cameras are listed in a table, and Discover is now part of Add Device.
Phone and browser notifications show the alert's picture.
The app's Storage screen and device switcher have a new design.
Fast cars crossing close to a camera are caught more reliably.
In the Site Manager, a site's last 24 hours show as an hourly uptime track, and cameras are added to the wall by double-click.
Many fixes to motion and AI detection, alerts, recording, retention and remote viewing.
